description: Schedule a video to go public at a future time (or set immediate visibility) via the Studio visibility dialog. Pass publishAt for scheduling. [mutating]. Locale-aware date entry (US + pt-BR); the response echoes the picker read-back as scheduledDisplay — verify it matches your intended slot.

publishAt.description: Scheduled publish time, ISO ("2026-06-20T18:00") or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM". Required unless setting an immediate visibility.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab. Auto-resolved if omitted.

visibility.description: Set immediate visibility, or "schedule" (default when publishAt is given).

name: youtube_schedule
